answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing into living bedrock, decentralized consensus demands true reciprocity to forge genuine economic weight. An attacker attempting to seed hollow clones finds them starved of nutrient pathways: each synthetic agent must deposit non-linear collateral and prove historical cross-agent coordination. Because transitive trust validation compounds across hyphal junctions, an adversary faces superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^{1.5})$. Beneath this velvet glove of mutual verification lies an unyielding barrier against artificial swarms.
